question: Can a trainable two-level pairwise conjunction module learn the relation of four actually observed raw noisy causal A cues, without receiving an explicit four-way parity product, under factual selected-action reward alone? Does a frozen experimental sidecar on original 32-wide nontransformer native Hybrid improve over strong same-input native flat sidecar and fully trained conventional MLP/GRU controls?
null: An engineered binary interaction tree is a strong structural prior, not invention of a new relation type. The original parity law is commutative, so role-binding and causal importance of ordered roles are NOT identifiable here. This program tests TEST-only same-family causal cue composition, not unfamiliar causal law, whole 224-tick native cold retention, independent native intelligence, fused GPU or production efficiency.

source.public_input: Original R86 48 selected real timeline rows compressed to 5 actually observed A probe and factual chosen pivot rows via R88 pure lawful _public_slots; for learnable conjunction, only actual observed noisy role-indexed cues at slot[:4,10], selected action flags from pivot row, public pivot time; NO computed parity, private law, alternate reward or teacher labels to learned tree arms
source.selected_training_action: CALIBRATE iff ((floor(index/4)+seed_index)%2==0), otherwise EXPLOIT_POS, stratum balance by pivot (index%2), public-unseen source law index stratum ((index%512)//2)%2, selected action; private law only design/evaluator, not model input
source.factual_supervision: One chosen intervention and actually realized 9-tick reward per training world only; no paired/unselected return in FIT/FIT_VALIDATION
source.heldout_first_use: Generate NEW DEV and NEW shifted OOD (same four-factor law with different probe timing/noise) only AFTER all eight arms fully trained and weights frozen, independent two seeds
source.prohibited: Never call prior _world/_test_world, original spent source panels, reserved science source or access old weights

architecture.native_core: Existing R74 original HybridPilot_FULL width32 + R75 mathematically equivalent causal triangular TTT, original hard depth router, no native source modification; three native arms same initial native core parameters and same 5x13 publicly observed rows
architecture.sidecar: TRAINABLE separate residual value head added to original native core pivot readout, not proof of internal native representation learning. Flat sidecar gets same raw four cues+actual action+timestamp; tree sidecar learns pair encodings from raw four noisy cues using a shared two-input MLP and a second learned two-pair merger then reads with action/time; no hand-coded parity/multiplication in either trainable sidecar
architecture.MLP_raw: Existing R87 PublicValueMLP 8D raw A cues/action/time, 4801 parameters and factual return
architecture.MLP_tree: Same two-stage learned pair encoding with factual return readout as sidecar; same raw factual information as MLP raw, different parameter count, disclose
architecture.MLP_upper: Existing R87 4801-param MLP with PUBLIC deterministic product of 4 observed cue signs; evaluator-style diagnostic ceiling only, explicitly programmed
architecture.shuffled_negative: Same trainable tree architecture/optimizer as MLP_TREE, but cross-world A cue vectors exchanged within actually public pivot+logged-action groups for training and within pivot group in evaluator-only paired DEV/OOD, preserve current action and actual factual return; no hidden labels
architecture.GRU: Existing R81 GRU64 on original 5x13 public slots, 15233 parameters; stronger conventional sequence reader, same legal factual observations
architecture.role_identity_prior: A events already selected/sorted using public role ID; cannot claim learned role discovery
